hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(core/|tests/).*\.py'; then python -m unittest discover -s tests 2>&1 | tail -5; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'git (commit|push)'; then if git diff --cached -U0 | grep -qE '^\+.*(sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}|OPENAI_API_KEY *= *[^ ]|RESEND_API_KEY *= *[^ ])'; then echo 'BLOQUEADO: possivel chave de API no commit'; exit 2; fi; fi
